# Getting help

- **How do I run it, and what does it do?** Start with the [README](../README.md), then [`CONTEXT.md`](../CONTEXT.md)
  for what the words mean and [`docs/`](../docs/README.md) for the decisions behind them.
- **Something's broken, or a number looks wrong:** open an issue with the
  [bug or wrong-number template](https://github.com/I0B0M/Stone/issues/new/choose). Search the existing issues first.
- **An idea or a question:** open an issue with the feature request template, or a blank one for a question.
- **A security problem:** follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not a public issue.

Precedence is maintained by two people in their spare time, so replies can take a few days.
